title: Sector Nine Rising Revisited
author: J. M. Thornbury
blurb: Quentin Brightwater, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
